hotel.name: Grand Horizon Hotel
hotel.description: Grand Horizon Hotel is a modern 4-star property located in the heart of the city, offering comfortable rooms, an outdoor pool, and easy access to major business and tourist districts.

amenities.name: Swimming Pool
amenities.description: Outdoor swimming pool open daily from 6:00 AM to 9:00 PM, located on the 2nd floor terrace.

amenities.name: Wi-Fi
amenities.description: Free high-speed Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel, including all guest rooms and public areas.

amenities.name: Parking
amenities.description: Complimentary self-parking is available for all hotel guests, subject to availability.

amenities.name: Gym
amenities.description: A 24-hour fitness center is available on the ground floor for all in-house guests.

amenities.name: Restaurant
amenities.description: The in-house restaurant, Horizon Kitchen, serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner daily.

policies.cancellation: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before the check-in date. Cancellations made within 48 hours of check-in are subject to a one-night charge.
policies.pets: Pets are not allowed at Grand Horizon Hotel, with the exception of registered service animals.
policies.parking: Complimentary self-parking is available on-site for all guests, subject to availability.
policies.wifi: Free high-speed Wi-Fi is provided throughout the property at no additional cost.
policies.breakfast: Complimentary breakfast is included with all room bookings and is served from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM at Horizon Kitchen.

faq.question: What time is check-in and check-out?
faq.answer: Check-in starts at 2:00 PM and check-out is by 11:00 AM. Early check-in or late check-out may be available on request, subject to availability.

faq.question: Is breakfast included in the room price?
faq.answer: Yes, complimentary breakfast is included with all bookings and served from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM.

faq.question: Does the hotel have a swimming pool?
faq.answer: Yes, Grand Horizon Hotel has an outdoor swimming pool on the 2nd floor terrace, open daily from 6:00 AM to 9:00 PM.

faq.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faq.answer: Free cancellation is available up to 48 hours before check-in. Cancellations within 48 hours are charged for one night.

faq.question: Is parking available?
faq.answer: Yes, complimentary self-parking is available on-site for all guests, subject to availability.

faq.question: Are pets allowed?
faq.answer: Pets are not allowed, except for registered service animals.

faq.question: Which room is suitable for a family of four?
faq.answer: The Family Suite, with 1 king bed and a sofa bed, accommodates up to 4 adults and is the best fit for families.

faq.question: Is Wi-Fi free?
faq.answer: Yes, free high-speed Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel, including all guest rooms.
